description: The idiomatic method_missing shape: `def method_missing(name, *args)`. RETARGETED to true on 2026-09-01 (clink 34/39). The original reading -- FLAGGED ty_language_gap, 'Ty's arrow spine has no vararg/rest-arity constructor, so there is no Ty value that honestly describes this parameter list' -- was about writing down a *signature*, and this checker never writes one: `callDef`/`callMissing` type the body once per call-site argument shape (tier 6). So the rest parameter needs no arity spine at all; `paramBind` binds `*args` to `arrayOf (elemTy <the remaining argument types>)`, which is the second of the two fixes the original description itself proposed ('or modeling a rest param as arrayOf Ty'). Climbed by tier 14b's rest-parameter rows, with nothing added here. Its companion proc-arity-leniency is *not* fixed by the same work and is not a Ty gap either: it needs `Ty.clos` to record whether a callable is a proc or a lambda, since only a proc's arity is lenient.
